race.description: Audenzia Itc Horse Of The Year Hcp (C1)
race.comment: PHILATELIC (3) was edged out first-up at Hawkesbury then got a long way back before making significant inroads to grab second last start over 1400m at Newcastle. Likely to peak for this over the slightly longer journey. SAVOONGA (6) had a soft run at the back of a small field then lengthened nicely to collect her maiden over 1350m at Wyong last time out. Progressive mare who looks capable of climbing to another level here. COSTABIT (4) has been in the market but disappointing in two runs since a minor placing at Hawkesbury over this trip on 23 June. The stable is persevering deep into the prep so he might have more to offer today. VELIA (7) was a despised roughie but charged home to be beaten just a length when resuming over 1300m here recently. Good lightweight hope over the extra 200m second-up. ICEFORD (1) is trialling well and looks ready for a bright return from a 21-week lay-off.
